title: Faisal Town Phase 2 Master Plan: O, P, Q, R, S & T Sector Guide
seoTitle: Faisal Town Phase 2 Master Plan – O, P, Q, R, S & T
metaDescription: View the Faisal Town Phase 2 master plan and official plans for Sector O, P, Q, R, S and T, with cash vs installment guidance.
description: A focused map guide to the full Phase 2 layout and the official O, P, Q, R, S and T sector plans.
intro: Use the full Phase 2 master plan for project-wide orientation, then open the official sector plan for O, P, Q, R, S or T when checking a specific plot. The current buying route also differs: O/P/Q/R are cash-only Model Blocks, while S/T are installment sectors.
body:
## What the Phase 2 master plan is for

The full Faisal Town Phase 2 master plan helps you understand how the major sectors, roads and planned areas relate to one another. It is an orientation tool, not a live availability list.

## Cash-only Model Blocks on the current inventory

Sector O, Sector P, Sector Q and Sector R are currently cash-only Model Blocks. Sector P / The Caladan has its own premium price plan; Sector O, Q and R currently use the shared cash price references from 8 Marla upward.

- [Sector O / Model Block](/faisal-town-o-block/)
- [Sector P / The Caladan](/faisal-town-p-block/)
- [Sector Q / Model Block](/faisal-town-q-block/)
- [Sector R / Model Block](/faisal-town-r-block/)

## Installment sectors

Sector S and Sector T are currently installment options. Sector T has a confirmed 5.56 Marla listed entry at PKR 27.90 Lac. Sector S should be checked for the latest available sizes and payment schedule.

- [Sector S](/faisal-town-sector-s/)
- [Sector T](/faisal-town-sector-t/)

## Overseas, W and X

These areas appear in the current planning material, but there is no current entry/inventory being promoted there. Use them as location references on the master plan rather than active sales sections.

## Master plan vs sector plan

Use the full master plan to answer: where is this sector in the wider project? Use the dedicated sector plan to answer: where is this plot inside Sector O, P, Q, R, S or T?

The site now provides the official plan PDFs for all six active sectors: O, P, Q, R, S and T.

## How to verify one plot

Ask for the sector, plot number and size, then request the exact available plot marked on the correct sector plan. Check road width, corner or standard position, nearby open space and connection to the wider road network.

## Map location is not live availability

A plan can show plot dimensions, roads, parks and planned land uses. It cannot prove that a particular plot is available today. Confirm live inventory separately on WhatsApp.

## Map location is not current development

After identifying the plot on the plan, check current access, road work, plot demarcation and surrounding development through a site visit or current live video.

## Before payment

Confirm whether the sector is cash-only or installment, the exact plot, current payable amount or payment schedule, dues, special-location charges, payment recipient and receipt process before making a material payment.

[Download the full Faisal Town Phase 2 master plan PDF](/assets/faisal-town-ii/faisal-town-phase-2-master-plan.pdf)

faqsText:
Which sectors are cash-only Model Blocks? | Sector O, Sector P, Sector Q and Sector R are currently cash-only Model Blocks.
Which sectors are currently on installments? | Sector S and Sector T are currently the installment options.
Are official sector plans available? | Yes. This site now links the official plans for Sector O, P, Q, R, S and T.
Can the plan confirm current availability? | No. The plan shows layout; current available plot numbers must be confirmed separately.
Is Overseas/W/X currently an active entry? | No current entry/inventory is being promoted there; those areas remain useful as master-plan references.
